steps.songs: Each interval has a sound of its own, and songs help you remember it. “Amazing Grace” opens with a perfect fourth, “When the Saints Go Marching In” with a major third, and in “Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star” the leap after the first two notes is a perfect fifth.
steps.listen: Listen, and think of how each song begins.
steps.character: A minor third sounds darker than a major third, and an octave sounds like the same note, higher.
steps.build: Last one: find them with the sound you have in your head.
